summary: Master the art of Bank Asset and Liability Management with our comprehensive course. Gain insights into techniques that drive financial stability and growth.
lede: Bank asset and liability management (ALM) training covers how banking professionals measure interest rate and liquidity risks and assess balance-sheet structure. For treasury, risk, finance, and ALM teams, it builds practical skills in analyzing repricing gaps and sensitivities, monitoring liquidity through ladders and stress scenarios, and preparing funds transfer pricing outputs and clear ALCO reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support ALM analysis, treasury reporting, liquidity oversight, and balance sheet decision-making in banking environments.
audience: Product Pricing Manager using FTP signals
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisite: working knowledge of banking products, balance sheet terminology, and basic financial statement interpretation. You should be comfortable using spreadsheets for calculations and reports; no programming is required. Familiarity with ALCO reporting, interest rate risk concepts, and liquidity terminology will help you move faster, but the course starts from foundation to intermediate level and builds methodically.
